game.title: Rift Spire: Pantheon
ev.well.title: Ancient Well
ev.well.body: A stone well stands in the corridor, its water strangely clear.
ev.well.o0_0: Cool water revives you. Heal 20% HP.
ev.well.o0_1: The water is bitter. Lose 10% HP.
ev.merchant.title: Strange Trader
ev.merchant.body: A hooded trader holds out two small pouches.
ev.merchant.o0_0: More gold inside than you thought. Gain 120 Gold.
ev.merchant.o0_1: The pouch is nearly empty. Lose 40 Gold.
ev.altar.title: Broken Altar
ev.altar.body: A cracked altar still glows faintly.
ev.altar.o0_0: The glow warms. You gain a Ward Charm.
ev.altar.o0_1: A cold wave passes. Lose 15% HP.
ev.altar.o1_0: Your respect is rewarded with a few EXP Cakes.
ev.crossroad.title: Fork of Fate
ev.crossroad.body: Two paths open: one bright, one dark.
ev.crossroad.o0_0: The bright path leads to a small cache. Gain 60 Gold.
ev.crossroad.o0_1: The light was a mirage. Lose 10% HP.
ev.crossroad.o1_0: In the dark lies a Rare Stone!
ev.crossroad.o1_1: You grope around and find only a few EXP Cakes.
ev.whisper.title: Whispering Voice
ev.whisper.body: A voice of unknown origin whispers in your ear.
ev.whisper.o0_0: The voice guides you to a Stone.
ev.whisper.o0_1: It was just the wind. Disoriented, lose 8% HP.
ev.statue.title: Weeping Statue
ev.statue.body: A stone statue weeps from its eyes.
ev.statue.o0_0: The statue seems relieved. Heal 15% HP.
ev.statue.o1_0: You leave the statue in peace.
ev.bridge.title: Rotting Bridge
ev.bridge.body: A rotting bridge spans a chasm. Gold glints on the other side.
ev.bridge.o0_0: You make it and grab 100 Gold.
ev.bridge.o0_1: The bridge snaps; you cling on, scraped. Lose 20% HP.
ev.bridge.o1_0: The detour is slow but safe.
ev.cache.title: Hidden Cellar
ev.cache.body: A small cellar lies beneath a loose slab.
ev.cache.o1_0: You decide not to meddle and move on.

story.s0.title: The In-Between
story.s0.body: The alarms fall silent. The Cupola drifts at the edge of something taller than any building ever made: the Spire. AIDA, the station AI, reports that every clock is wrong. Only the control panel still glows, six kinds of orbs blinking as if waiting for a touch.
story.s1.title: Water Zone: The Rising Tide
story.s1.body: Water rises from a place with no sea. In the surf, Thuy Tinh appears from the torn memory of a Vietnamese legend: a god demanding back what was never his. The Shadows around him are only echoes. AIDA notes: "They are not evil. They are lost."
story.s2.title: Fire Zone: The Iron Whip
story.s2.body: Fire does not rise; it falls like rain. In memory, a boy swells into a giant, an iron whip sweeping the sky. On the control panel, the glass above the screen has fogged slightly. AIDA says it is only condensation, though outside there is only vacuum.
story.s3.title: Wood Zone: The Seed
story.s3.body: A forest grows from bare rock. Every melon seed that sprouts is a promise to survive on a barren island. The Cupola trembles in a steady rhythm, like fingers tapping on a table. AIDA measures the frequency but cannot find the source.
story.s4.title: Light Zone: The Lyre
story.s4.body: Light arrives from a horizon with no sun. The melody of a lyre echoes through the void, and the Shadows around it slow as if listening. Apollo cannot remember how he came here, but he remembers the music perfectly.
story.s5.title: Dark Zone: The Watcher
story.s5.body: The night of Nyx covers everything. On the observation screen, a figure stands very far away, silent, looking toward the Cupola. When AIDA asks who it is, the figure answers: "I am keeping it from falling." Then the signal dies. None of the missing crew has been found.
story.s6.title: Heart Zone: Mending
story.s6.body: At the end of this season a colossal Shadow collapses, not defeated but spent: it was only the Spire's own reaction, like a body pushing out a foreign thing. The gods begin to remember home. In the station log there is a strange timestamp: someone opened the module door the night before the incident.

tut.1: Dragging: press an orb, drag across cells, then release. Orbs you pass are pushed aside. You have about 5 seconds per move.
tut.2: Match 3 or more of a kind to clear them. Chains build combos and multiply damage. Orbs matching a character's element deal damage; Heart orbs heal the whole team. Link 5 or more gems of one type: heroes of that element hit all enemies.
tut.3: Water beats Fire, Fire beats Wood, Wood beats Water; Light and Dark beat each other. Tap a ready character to use its skill. Adjacent Duo partners get a Duo button.

help.t1: Drag an orb anywhere on the board, diagonals included. Release when the timer ends or you're happy with the path.
help.t2: 3 or more orbs of one color in a line burst. More combos, more damage.
help.t3: Orbs matching a character's element deal damage; heart orbs heal the whole team.
help.t4: Tap a glowing "Ready" hero to use their skill. Two neighbors forming a Duo pair unlock a combined skill.
help.t5: Tap an enemy to lock the target for the whole team. Hold a hero or enemy for details.

load.tip.1: Match 3 or more gems of one colour to chain combos. The more combos, the more damage.
load.tip.2: Gems matching a hero's element boost that hero's attack. Build a team with several colours.
load.tip.3: Tap a hero whose skill is ready to preview it, then confirm to cast.
load.tip.4: Heroes standing side by side can trigger a Duo. Try swapping positions in your team.
load.tip.5: The first slot is the Leader. Pick your sturdiest hero or the one with the best leader skill.
load.tip.6: Leaving the tower between floors costs nothing. Come back and continue exactly where you stopped.
load.tip.7: At a fork, inns restore HP and chests give items. Guess what you need most.
load.tip.8: AIDA has chosen you. Each floor is a crack in the old world. Climb and see what it hides.
